_description: State tax applied to capital gains (LTCG). California 8% state rate × $64,935 taxable withdrawal = $5,195 state LTCG tax; federal LTCG (15%) = $9,740.
_rationale: Single filer, age 60, California. $1M taxable account, no other income, $50k living expenses, no growth, no inflation. All spending comes from taxable account. Withdrawal w must net $50k after federal LTCG 15% + state LTCG 8% = 23%. Therefore w = 50000/0.77 = 64935.07. Federal LTCG = $9,740.26; State LTCG = $5,194.81; total tax = $14,935.07. Balance year 1 = 1,000,000 − 64,935.07 = $935,064.93. Verifies state LTCG modeling without IRMAA or NIIT interference.
name: State LTCG
